description: Source code for Bluetooth HCI IPC communication in Zephyr RTOS, handling HCI commands, ACL, ISO data, and system error handling.

methods.name: hci_ipc_cmd_recv
methods.description: Receives and processes HCI command packets from data buffer.

methods.name: hci_ipc_acl_recv
methods.description: Receives and processes HCI ACL data packets from data buffer.

methods.name: hci_ipc_iso_recv
methods.description: Receives and processes HCI ISO data packets from data buffer.

methods.name: hci_ipc_rx
methods.description: Dispatches received data to appropriate packet handler based on packet indicator.

methods.name: tx_thread
methods.description: Thread function for transmitting buffers via Bluetooth stack.

methods.name: hci_ipc_send
methods.description: Sends HCI buffers over IPC, handling retries and logging.

methods.name: bt_ctlr_assert_handle
methods.description: Handles controller assertions, disables interrupts, and sends fatal error events.

methods.name: k_sys_fatal_error_handler
methods.description: Handles system fatal errors, sends error events if possible, and halts system.

methods.name: hci_ept_bound
methods.description: Callback when IPC endpoint is bound, signals readiness.

methods.name: hci_ept_recv
methods.description: Callback when data is received on IPC endpoint, processes data.
